How It Works

You can help end poverty — starting in childhood

Three ways your support changes a child's future permanently. Every naira goes directly to a child's journey.

💛

Sponsor a Child

Make a consistent monthly commitment that gives a specific child access to education, mentorship, skills training, and regular progress updates delivered to you.

From ₦20,000/month
🎯

Any amount

Give your time and expertise. Be matched with a child who needs your professional guidance. Virtual, flexible, and structured to work around your life.

1 hour/month minimum

The TACE Journey

From vulnerability to independence

We do not just give money. We walk with every child through nine structured stages — from the moment they are identified, all the way to employment and business ownership.

1
Identify
We find vulnerable children through community outreach, school referrals, and partner organisations.
2
Assess
Every child is assessed for their needs, situation, and what kind of support would make the biggest difference.
3
Educate & Support
School fees, learning materials, tutoring, and examination support — keeping children in school.
4
Mentor
Every child is matched with a professional mentor who guides them monthly — virtually or in person.
5
Train & Apprentice
Vocational skills training in our enterprise centres — real skills in a real business environment.
6
Employ & Empower
Job placement, business startup support, and savings — building a foundation for lifelong independence.

"I didn't know what was possible for me."

Every child who enters the TACE journey leaves it with a skill, a plan, and a future.

Mentorship Programme

Every child deserves a guide

Financial support changes circumstances. Mentorship changes trajectories. Every TACE beneficiary is matched with a professional mentor who walks with them — virtually, consistently, purposefully.

🎯

Professional Matching

We match each child with a mentor whose profession aligns with their aspirations and interests.

💬

Safe, Monitored Connection

All communication happens on the TACE platform — secure, consent-based, and admin-visible.

📊

Monthly Progress

Mentors submit a brief monthly update. Every child's development is tracked and documented.

Our Programmes

Six ways we walk with children

From keeping a child in school to walking them into a career — TACE programmes are designed to address every stage of a child's journey to independence.

📚

Education Support

School fees, learning materials, WAEC registration, tutoring, and academic monitoring for vulnerable children.

Learn more →
🛠️

Vocational Training

Hands-on skills training in our enterprise centres — hair, barbering, tailoring, catering, graphics, and more.

Learn more →
🤝

Mentorship

Every beneficiary is matched with a professional mentor for career and character guidance — monthly, virtual, purposeful.

Learn more →
🎯

Career Discovery

Professionals visit secondary schools to expose students to careers and futures they never knew were possible.

Learn more →
🏥

Health Outreach

Medical screenings, health awareness campaigns, nutrition support, and healthcare referrals for beneficiaries.

Learn more →
🏭

Enterprise & Apprenticeship

Real business training in TACE-owned enterprise centres — leading to certification, savings, and employment.

Learn more →
